<p id="u1d34dc13" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">张雪峰老师的突然逝世，全网都感到无比的悲痛，他说：钱财早已不重要，能实实在在帮到普通人，才是活着的意义。为此他长期的身心透支，默默地付出着自己。</span></p>
<p id="udf5d3b64" class="ne-p"><img width="338.49029541015625" id="u739542e6" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/27571985/1774413871528-29dda176-c1f0-434d-908f-66d9318f8dea.jpeg"></p>
<p id="u67c35ebf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">看到不少博主推送的消息，都说：<strong><span class="ne-text">张雪峰老师很累，长期拼搏到凌晨</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，为了验证一下这个结果，我以微博里张雪峰老师发送的微博内容<strong><span class="ne-text">使用AI全流程开发一个简单的爬虫，系统分析一下结果。</span></strong></span></span></p>
<p id="ufe096380" class="ne-p"><img width="360.49029541015625" id="ud3d29cc7" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/27571985/1774415849083-62454dd9-2fd0-4686-93fe-a3905b04b14c.jpeg"></p>
<h1 id="QDBOB"><span class="ne-text">一、AI写爬虫代码</span></h1>
<p id="uaa4b14b5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我这里使用的是trae这个开发工具，使用GPT5的模型来完成全流程开发</span></p>
<p id="ub3c1b975" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们先来到微博的移动端，打开张雪峰老师的主页：<a class="ne-link" href="https://m.weibo.cn/p/2304131676679984" target="_blank" data-href="https://m.weibo.cn/p/2304131676679984" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="ne-text">https://m.weibo.cn/p/2304131676679984</span></a></span></p>
<p id="uf4fdc0e3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">通过搜索微博内容，我们定位到了查询微博内容的API接口如下</span></p>
<p id="u76656027" class="ne-p"><img width="1388.88315128681" id="udc1d7648" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774407184681-e448411e-f51a-4f9e-ac6c-519fc4e18dd2.png"></p>
<p id="u54636e2b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">因为提示词较多，我们可以新建一个txt文档，然后编写好对应的微博爬虫需求，并提供API示例给到AI</span></p>
<p id="u9c28d6fa" class="ne-p"><img width="1143.896132231282" id="u52255fd4" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774407350705-ce2acc81-d523-4370-8245-64ae01443fe0.png"></p>
<p id="u26040a95" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">提示词如下：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>使用python帮我实现微博爬虫，我需要爬取某一个用户下发表的所有微博记录，并将数据输出到csv格式的文件里。要求如下：

1、查询微博记录的API接口如下：
url = "https://m.weibo.cn/api/container/getIndex"
params = {
    "containerid": "2304131676679984"   # 用户id
}
response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
数据返回示例：{填写实际返回的数据}

2、分页的API接口如下：
url = "https://m.weibo.cn/api/container/getIndex"
params = {
    "containerid": "2304131676679984",
    "page_type": "03",   # 页面类型，固定
    "since_id": "5260895959385732"      # 好像是通过这个进行分页的
}
response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)

2、csv格式要求如下：
微博记录id,微博内容,微博发送时间</code></pre>
<p id="uc64ff721" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">紧接着，我们引用一下这个txt文档，让AI用python来帮我们实现一下</span></p>
<p id="uf77b5afb" class="ne-p"><img width="384.6233861507908" id="ubc1f02db" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774407420627-5a052894-c12f-4206-a88d-4cb20050d973.png"></p>
<p id="u11349a97" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">接下来，就是静静地等待了，你可以去摸摸鱼，散个步放松一下心情，</span></p>
<p id="u1ea465a6" class="ne-p"><img width="392.7272824554266" id="u85e80614" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774407552437-3cef6bfa-06e4-4339-9efd-4dc3866b6e7b.png"></p>
<p id="uc42dde10" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">他给了我带命令行的版本，可是我本人并不喜欢命令行这种方式，我喜欢直接在代码里填入参数的方式。</span></p>
<p id="ua1e16875" class="ne-p"><img width="382.7532562343364" id="de1ry" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774408140380-f31fd57a-3bd3-40a7-b760-551a88c1c9ab.png"></p>
<p id="u3b6de0c6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">于是我告诉他的提示词如下：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>我不要使用带命令行的，我需要直接封装成函数，我直接在代码里填入相应的参数，爬取的页数就能够自动获取微博内容结果</code></pre>
<p id="u0f4d3c98" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">很快，AI就帮我改好了</span></p>
<p id="u4fc7a626" class="ne-p"><img width="380.88312631788193" id="uf54437f7" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774408569770-a7cc21b2-a431-4dbc-abb0-6631c0d55c61.png"></p>
<p id="uf870a4b8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们来运行一下代码，跑一下看看，输出了一个weibo_posts.csv的文件，我们打开看一眼，已经基本上满足了我们的要求，但是发现时间格式不正确，我希望把时间格式化成：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss这种格式的。</span></p>
<p id="u03f08028" class="ne-p"><img width="981.8182061385664" id="u70ee8dfb" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774408520062-744c165d-acd4-4d7d-8cbd-27b4b0b99a63.png"></p>
<p id="ue3877052" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">于是我给了他下面的提示词：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>weibo_posts.csv 2-2 这个文件的时间格式请格式化成：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</code></pre>
<p id="u75584bf9" class="ne-p"><img width="381.5065029567001" id="u7d85de6d" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774408634298-47e72b50-04d0-4ad6-9a0d-07793cd4d67e.png"></p>
<p id="u2f94a892" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">很快他就帮我改好了代码，并输出了正确的结果。这是爬取下来的部分结果：</span></p>
<p id="uf651a578" class="ne-p"><img width="851.5324886255756" id="u089a6ce4" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774413456297-fc46f79c-66b5-4379-af8f-1ca4c6876170.png"></p>
<p id="u8a2c2e10" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">写完爬虫这部分的代码所花费的时间不到10分钟，不得不说，AI开发效率是真的提升巨大！</span></strong></p>
<h1 id="Qg8Pw"><span class="ne-text">二、AI生成词云图</span></h1>
<p id="u64918a49" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">紧接着，我们生成一下词云图，AI提示词如下，在这里，我的习惯是：<strong><span class="ne-text">鼓励一下AI，并承诺做得好，给他大大的奖励！</span></strong></span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>请你根据生成好的weibo_posts.csv这个文件，生成具体的高频词云图，越高频的词语在图片上越大。
请一定要发挥你全部的实力，做得好，我会给你一笔丰富的报酬！</code></pre>
<p id="ua0abb897" class="ne-p"><img width="388.3636459836996" id="u5276e8b1" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774409340724-cb5b34e3-d07b-4443-945b-5dad19ff8e5d.png"></p>
<p id="u9fb15b99" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">AI又开始给我干活了，我们耐心等待几分钟。</span></p>
<p id="u88259adf" class="ne-p"><img width="392.7272824554266" id="u4ef9d4fd" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774409722168-53215220-445d-4387-b7ec-0380c9be57da.png"></p>
<p id="u934f2b12" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">期间可能会出现AI的想法和你的想法不一致的情况，比如：</span></p>
<p id="u8c5d5de0" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">1、我希望他随机休眠时间，而不是固定1个时间</span></strong></p>
<p id="u318b7082" class="ne-p"><img width="337.87013823943045" id="u41c65f68" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774412663343-95ffaa84-ccdf-41eb-840e-71dd0a880c0f.png"></p>
<p id="u7b6dd434" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">2、我希望他爬取完1页就输出到csv文件，而不是全部爬完才输出csv文件</span></strong></p>
<p id="uc7016a3b" class="ne-p"><img width="335.3766316841579" id="u33bff669" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774412673699-ecd5a3ea-dc31-4850-a1e3-b39cf0b1ffd0.png"></p>
<p id="ubcfedbd8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">等等.....</span></p>
<p id="u21565777" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果出现了，<strong><span class="ne-text">不要害怕，直接跟AI提出你的要求，让他一直改，改到你认为完美为止！</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="uf075e072" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">当他把代码全部改完后，我们运行一下代码：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>python weibo_spider.py</code></pre>
<p id="ue29e176f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这是我用<strong><span class="ne-text">张雪峰老师2025-2026年所有的微博记录结果生成出来的词云图</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：</span></span></p>
<p id="u62ce4f71" class="ne-p"><img width="1122.0779498726474" id="uf5441229" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774413537549-4772012a-a462-4422-8f02-3b028261a77c.png"></p>
<p id="u6e4a6b8a" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">统计出来的热门高频词如下</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：</span></p>
<p id="u4b702ad2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">[('高考', 27), ('志愿', 16), ('雪峰', 16), ('考生', 12), ('知道', 12), ('夸克', 12), ('问题', 11), ('孩子', 11), ('考研', 9), ('专业', 9)]</span></p>
<p id="u9d0d1066" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这是<strong><span class="ne-text">2025-2026年</span></strong><span class="ne-text">反映情绪的形容词词频提取结果：</span></span></p>
<p id="ub8d4fbda" class="ne-p"><img width="1122.0779498726474" id="mJDM1" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774415516182-d5c44962-e519-4db2-b03b-50dfeb646ff5.png"></p>
<p id="u24da4850" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">情感词Top10: [('疯狂', 2), ('开心', 2), ('难受', 2), ('喜欢', 2), ('着急', 1), ('欣慰', 1), ('感谢', 1), ('快乐', 1), ('满足', 1), ('紧张', 1)]</span></p>
<h1 id="vlOTZ"><span class="ne-text">三、AI统计活跃时间段</span></h1>
<p id="ue50515cd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">先上提示词：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>请使用python代码，帮我统计一下：活跃时间段，是上午、下午、还是晚上更为活跃？</code></pre>
<p id="u7d3ad07a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">很快，他就帮助我改完了代码，并提供了调用示例，和返回结果示例，而且他还非常友好的告知我：是否需要生成活跃度柱状图？</span></p>
<p id="u6548995e" class="ne-p"><img width="385.870139428427" id="uddd50f9c" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774412727296-464ea604-cad3-4a36-b2c0-6de32f30c14b.png"></p>
<p id="u08fe84b3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">那我肯定是需要这个图啦，文字哪有图带来的直观效果，于是我立马让他帮我实现</span></p>
<p id="uf62578e6" class="ne-p"><img width="383.3766328731545" id="u2ba04be6" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774412807322-f6d2b814-9086-4afb-aabe-c0c594383d65.png"></p>
<p id="u73ce09a7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">实现好之后，他会告诉我如何调用，我们参照他的调用示例，运行代码即可生成活跃时间柱状图啦！</span></p>
<p id="u58932421" class="ne-p"><img width="385.870139428427" id="uf3ec995b" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774412879743-b7e2fb6c-6419-4dba-b63c-27610785cb18.png"></p>
<p id="u8554f2a8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">相关运行代码展示：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 爬取记录
    # max_page = 0
    # result = execute_spider(max_page)
    # print(f"完成: 共导出{len(result)}条记录")

    # 生成词云图
    top_words = generate_wordcloud_from_csv(csv_path='weibo_posts.csv')
    top10 = list(top_words.items())[:10]
    print("词云生成完成: weibo_wordcloud.png")
    print(f"Top10词频: {top10}")

    # 统计活跃时间段
    result = analyze_active_period_from_csv(
        csv_path=r"e:\workspace-trae\weibo_spider\weibo_posts.csv"
    )
    print("活跃时间段：", result)
    chart_result = generate_active_bar_charts_from_csv(
        csv_path=r"e:\workspace-trae\weibo_spider\weibo_posts.csv",
        period_chart_path=r"e:\workspace-trae\weibo_spider\weibo_active_period_bar.png",
        hour_chart_path=r"e:\workspace-trae\weibo_spider\weibo_active_hour_bar.png",
    )
    print("活跃时间段柱状图已输出：", chart_result)</code></pre>
<p id="u54f2c9ce" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们运行一下，就能得到如下的柱状图结果：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>{
    "总数": 129,
    "计数": {
        "上午": 46,
        "下午": 48,
        "晚上": 35
    },
    "占比": {
        "上午": "35.66%",
        "下午": "37.21%",
        "晚上": "27.13%"
    },
    "最活跃时段": "下午"
}</code></pre>
<p id="uc1ca11d7" class="ne-p"><img width="1745.4545886907847" id="u30300ca1" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774413082319-58556625-73ee-4c85-bc88-13aa8b8a628f.png"></p>
<p id="u13ff1ae1" class="ne-p"><img width="1246.7532776362748" id="u61cf8ee7" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774413090000-73c3c88c-faaf-4304-ac52-63481f717c26.png"></p>
<p id="u095bc466" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从柱状图可以看出：<strong><span class="ne-text">张雪峰老师下午开始在微博比较活跃，凌晨1-2点也还在努力拼搏中...</span></strong></span></p>
<h1 id="i8bln"><span class="ne-text">四、AI生成情感分析结果</span></h1>
<p id="u23c977f8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">先上提示词：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>请使用帮我生成情感分析结果，判断该微博内容是积极还是消极，并打分（0-1），情感分析结果输出格式：
微博记录id,微博内容,微博发送时间,情感得分,分析结果</code></pre>
<p id="u78ff00cd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">中间的过程我就省略了，等待AI改写完成后，我们运行一下代码，就能得到如下的csv文档打标结果：</span></p>
<p id="u34002f8e" class="ne-p"><img width="451.49029541015625" id="u03aa9303" class="ne-image lazyload" title="" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/27571985/1774414374992-2cc0408e-ff4f-4feb-9764-bffd4c5d2013.png"></p>
<p id="u7fc41b39" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">2025年-2026年最终情感分析结果：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>{
    "总数": 129,
    "积极": 94,
    "消极": 35,
    "积极占比": "72.87%",
    "消极占比": "27.13%",
    "输出文件": "weibo_posts_sentiment.csv",
    "模型": "规则词典"
}</code></pre>
<p id="uac4aa005" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从结果中可以看出：<span class="ne-text">72.87%的微博内容都是积极向上的。</span></span></p>
<h1 id="84a65445"><span class="ne-text">五、爬虫分析总结</span></h1>
<p id="uc4b5fda5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">2025年-2026年的微博内容分析结果，数据仅供参考：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u3fae7970" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">情感分析打标结果：积极占比72.87%。可以看出张雪峰老师是个乐观向上的人。</span></strong></li>
<li id="u6e092a9d" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">热门高频词统计结果："高考"、"志愿"、"考生"等是张雪峰老师非常关注的对象！"疯狂"、"开心"、"难受"、"想睡觉"等情绪词也表明雪峰老师可能存在经常熬夜的情况！</span></strong></li>
<li id="ue07dcdf0" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">活跃时间段：主要分布在“下午”和“晚上”，凌晨1-2点也经常还在努力拼搏中...</span></strong></li>
</ul>
<p id="ub258f232" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">他曾置身于教育资源博弈的寒冬，听过无数寒门求学者的叹息，即便身处全网质疑的暴风眼，他也未曾退缩。</span></p>
<p id="u3bd61afe" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">他的爆火与争议，本质上是时代焦虑的缩写，是千万普通人的需求投射。</span></p>
<p id="uab85b625" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">人间再无张雪峰，但他撕开现实裂缝后留下的那份真诚，以及关于“改写命运”的火种，将永远燃烧在时代深处。</span></p>
<p id="u8217b607" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">致敬！张雪峰老师！</span></p>
<h1 id="c1a6acb0"><span class="ne-text">六、<span class="ne-text">获取python完整源码</span></span></h1>
